name: Heart Fill
description: A heart shape fills suddenly from bottom to top in a dramatic heartbeat-style animation

variations.name: default
variations.description: Heart shape waits nearly empty then rapidly fills with color in a dramatic pulse, looping like a heartbeat

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color of the heart shape

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
